title: Circular queue
statementMd:
A bounded FIFO queue. `['enqueue', x]` returns `True` and adds if there is room, else `False`; `['dequeue']` returns the removed value or `-1` if empty; `['is_full']` returns a bool. Return the results of all operations.

**Example:** `circular_queue_ops(2, [["enqueue", 1], ["enqueue", 2], ["enqueue", 3], ["is_full"…)` returns `[true, true, false, true, 1]`.
